description: Historical US stock OHLCV bars with per-bar VWAP and trade count. Timeframes 1Min/5Min/15Min/1Hour/1Day; intraday bars include pre-market and after-hours sessions on the IEX feed. Each bar: {t, o, h, l, c, v, vwap, trades}. Use start/end ISO timestamps or a lookback shorthand like "2h", "5d". Multiple symbols comma-separated (max 20). BYOK Alpaca (free account). Example: alpaca_bars({ symbols: "AAPL", timeframe: "5Min", lookback: "1d", _apiKey: "key_id:secret_key" })

_apiKey.description: REQUIRED: your Alpaca credentials as "key_id:secret_key" — both halves joined by a colon. Free at alpaca.markets (a paper-trading account is enough for market data).

end.description: End time, ISO/RFC-3339 or date (default: now)

limit.description: Max bars per symbol to return, 1-1000 (default 100)

lookback.description: Shorthand window ending now, instead of start/end: e.g. "30m", "2h", "1d", "5d", "2w"

name: alpaca_bars
title: Alpaca Bars
